# Tier 4 — Supermedications
These three medications are strong in immediately healing large amounts of an entire group of damage.
However, they only fully metabolize in doses of 3 units or fewer and are not meant to mix with each other. [italic]You should dilute these![/italic]
Additionally, they produce helpful metabolites that may cause overdosing.
[textlink="Medical patches" link="MedicalPatches"] are excellent at administering appropriate doses of these supermedications. Take care to not overdose the patient with the metabolite, though.
